method.chunking: by markdown section; sections under 60 words merged, over 150 split (25-word overlap)
method.bm25_exact: Okapi BM25 (k1=1.2, b=0.75) over stemmed content words
method.bm25: bm25_exact plus joined-neighbour and nearest-term (trigram Dice >= 0.6) expansion
method.char_ngram: TF-IDF cosine over 3-5 character n-grams within words
method.fusion: Reciprocal Rank Fusion, k=60, over each ranker's top 20 chunks
method.confidence: length-weighted soft term coverage of the best of the top 3 fused chunks
method.metrics: document-level; recall/MRR ignore the confidence gate, which is scored separately
